extracted.name: Chickpea Salad with Red Onion and Tomato
extracted.description: This fabulous chickpea salad recipe is easy to prep in just 10 minutes with canned chickpeas and a zingy lemon, olive oil, garlic, and parsley dressing.
instruction_lines: Combine chickpeas, red onion, garlic, tomato, parsley, olive oil, and lemon juice in a large bowl; season with salt and pepper to taste.
